headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 14-5 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other news, the Baltimore Orioles dominated the Kansas City Royals 8-2, with Leody Taveras leading the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Zac Gallen being placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Chris Martin has also been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement. Additionally, Nick Lodolo has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a blister on his left index finger. Other players who have been impacted by injuries include William Kempner, Brandon Woodruff, Mike Yastrzemski, Anthony Banda, and Nick Kurtz.

The Milwaukee Brewers have bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Braden Shewmake in a trade with the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Toronto Blue Jays have traded RHP Tommy Nance to the Minnesota Twins for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 14-5 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Kansas City Royals 8-2, securing a decisive victory. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Shane Baz pitched 4.2 strong innings for the Royals.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. Ryan Yarbrough earned the win, while Paul Blackburn secured the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Alex Bregman leading the offense. Bregman hit 3 home runs, including a key 9th homer that scored two runs.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Shewmake Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Braden Shewmake to their roster, acquired in a trade from the Houston Astros. Shewmake joins the Brewers' infield on July 12, 2026.
